**Disclosure:** not financial advice. Only trade what you can afford to lose.

### Risk rules

- Hard stop at -5%.
- Never add to losers.

## Why it works

The rules exist so one bad morning cannot empty the account.

## Metrics to track

Max drawdown and average loser.
